get_remote_logger: create a RemoteLogger instance to send metrics to a remote ZMQ server for centralized logging
RemoteLogger_log_metrics: log metrics with a step number to the remote metric logging server via ZMQ
RemoteLogger_log_config: log a configuration dictionary to the remote metric logging server via ZMQ
MetricLoggingServer_init: start a ZMQ metric logging server process that accepts metrics from distributed workers
MetricLoggingServer_run_metric_zmq_serve: run a ZMQ PULL server loop that receives and writes metrics to wandb, tensorboard, or jsonl
